Marta (People Ops): Quick sync 126 calibration checklist + one legal ask about parental leave treatment across regions. Wanted to confirm process before we push the packet live.
Diego (Eng Manager): Thanks. What's the legal ask?
Marta (People Ops): Legal (Jules) flagged that some EMEA countries require special language when documenting performance during statutory parental leave periods. Need to make sure manager context blurbs are compliant and not evaluative for protected time.
Jules (Legal): Correct. Please do NOT include language implying diminished capability because of leave. Required phrasing: factual dates and "limited review" where appropriate, plus an objective list of scope performed. Example: "On parental leave 02/01-03/15 (statutory). Manager: limited-review for period; evaluated on active contribution dates only."
Sana (HRBP): So we should update the context-blurb template for all managers with the legal-safe phrasing and a short checkbox for "statutory leave" vs "other leave".
Marta (People Ops): Exactly. I'll paste the revised manager blurb template below; please adopt when writing notes. Also clarifying global payroll cutoffs and contractor conversion cutoffs in this thread.
Diego (Eng Manager): Cool, paste please.
Marta (People Ops): Manager Context Blurb (use verbatim where leave is involved):
```
- Active days in period: XX% (dates)
- Work summary: 1 sentence (objective deliverable / metric)
- Leave note (if applicable): "On statutory parental leave from YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD. Limited review applied; assessment based only on active days."
- Adjustment justification (if +1/-1): 1-2 sentences (tie to evidence)
```
Omar (Comp Ops): Adding comp notes: promotion or base pay changes that hit payroll must be finalized 10 business days before your country payroll cutoff. If you need to escalate a late comp-impact change, route to comp-ops + VP sign-off and include the estimated USD delta.
Diego (Eng Manager): What are the global cutoff dates for this cycle? My team is mixed US/EMEA.
Marta (People Ops): Global payroll cutoffs for retro changes this cycle (by region):
- US payroll cutoff: 2026-06-10 17:00 PT
- EMEA payroll cutoff: 2026-06-05 18:00 GMT
- APAC payroll cutoff: 2026-06-07 12:00 SGT
Note: these are retro-change cutoffs. Finalized ratings must be set earlier to allow comp ops review.
Sana (HRBP): Contractor conversion cutoff for inclusion in this cycle: convert effective on or before 2026-04-15. Later converts go to next cycle unless exception approved.
Diego (Eng Manager): If a converted contractor has a promotion request tied to conversion, do we handle it differently?
Omar (Comp Ops): If promotion was part of the conversion package, mark PROMO-CONV in the packet so comp ops picks it up immediately. Otherwise follow normal promo routing.
Jules (Legal): One more compliance note: for a few countries, employees have statutory rights that affect how we communicate rating outcomes. People Ops will attach a country-specific communication script to the packet for managers in those countries.
Marta (People Ops): Will do. Also adding a short exceptions template + process link. Exceptions need manager attestation + HRBP signoff before calibration packet inclusion.
hr-bot: Exception form: https://redwood.company/hr/exceptions  confirmation IDs auto-generated.
Marta (People Ops): Exception template to paste into ticket:
```
Employee: full name + role
Reason: (leave, late joiner, conversion, PIP, other)
Dates in scope: YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD
Manager attestation: 1-2 sentence justification
HRBP comment: required
Suggested handling: include / limited review / exclude
Attachments: links
```
Diego (Eng Manager): Deadlines for submissions? I have a manager OOO next week.
Marta (People Ops): Key dates: self-assessments due 2026-04-20 23:59 PT, manager packet uploads due 2026-04-27 17:00 PT, preflight & shadow checks 2026-04-28, calibration week 2026-05-04 - 2026-05-08. Exceptions to be submitted by 2026-04-26 17:00 PT to be in pre-calibration packet.
Sana (HRBP): If manager is OOO, a delegate can submit but must be L4+ and include a short attestation: "I reviewed and endorse these entries on behalf of manager X." Mark as reviewer_substitution in the packet.
Diego (Eng Manager): Appeals: can employees initiate directly?
Marta (People Ops): Employee can open an appeal but it must include manager acknowledgment. Flow: employee -> manager -> HRBP -> appeals panel (HRBP + 2 managers + comp ops). Appeals need to be filed within 10 business days of finalized ratings.
Omar (Comp Ops): Reminder: when tagging comp-impact, include estimated annualized USD delta and whether it's base/bonus/equity. Helps triage and budget forecast.
Jules (Legal): Please ensure all manager-facing text avoids subjective or discriminatory language. People Ops will run a quick audit on a sample of blurb texts pre-release.
Marta (People Ops): Final items: I'll publish the updated packet template with legal-safe blurb, the exceptions link, and a one-pager for managers tonight. If anyone wants a redacted sample of a properly completed blurb, DM me and I'll share.
Diego (Eng Manager): Thanks 44d will brief leads and forward the template.
hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: manager uploads due 2026-04-27 17:00 PT. Packet upload: https://redwood.company/hr/review-packets
Marta (People Ops): End of thread. Ping me @Marta for urgent cases or cross-border questions.
